comment: NativeJAM in a GraalVM image. 'jni' registers the JNI binding (the default -Djam.native.binding=jni) - unregistered native methods fail at call time with UnsatisfiedLinkError naming the JNI symbol: mmJni/jam_mm, newJni/jam_context_new and freeJni/jam_context_free. 'resources' embeds the bundled libjam and its .sha256, so NativeLoader can extract it to <tmpdir>/<sha256>/ and System.load it. 'foreign' (-H:+ForeignAPISupport is default-on in 25) registers every FFM descriptor NativeJAM creates: the jam_mm downcall for -Djam.native.binding=ffm; the ALWAYS-built jam_task_fn downcall void(begin, end, slot, task_user) and the jam_parallel_fn upcall stub void(count, task, task_user, user); and, FFM only, jam_pack_abi() -> jint, jam_pack_size(context, wt, m, k) -> jlong, jam_share(context, p, bytes, flags) -> jint, jam_unshare(context, p), jam_last_error(context) -> jlong and jam_isa_name(isa) -> jlong, a C string; a descriptor missing here makes NativeJAM's class init fail in the image and the provider silently absent, so every bind() in NativeJAM has its leaf type listed.
